_comment: Template for the platform/environment manifest required by the release rehearsal runbook. Fill in every field; a rehearsal run without a completed manifest is invalid.

clean_image.identifier: <VM snapshot name or container image digest>
clean_image.notes: <any deviations from a stock clean install>

installer.artifact: <path or URL to the installer script used>
installer.sha256: <SHA-256 hex digest of the installer artifact>
installer.binary_sha256: <SHA-256 hex digest of the installed binary>
